title: Fenwick Tree (Binary Indexed Tree)
summary: Answer prefix-sum questions in about log n steps by storing partial sums: position j holds the sum of the last (j & -j) values ending at j, so adding a value and summing a prefix both jump by lowest set bits.

complexity.time: O(n log n) build, O(log n) query

inputs.name: index
inputs.label: Index
inputs.note: The sum of the values from index 0 up to and including this index.

anchors.label: Add it to a position that covers it
Jump to the next covering position
Jump to the block before it
